d:
Gold Rush brings another round of tough decisions and unexpected setbacks! Todd Hoffman swallows his pride and tries to bring his old crew back. Meanwhile, Parker Schnabel faces a costly problem when his excavator gets stuck in a swamp, while Tony Beets gives his daughter Monica the chance to run her own mining operation. Can the miners overcome these challenges and keep their gold dreams alive?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 15, on Discovery Channel India.
